purpose: Individual original-speed motion excerpts for the hero, Abstract, Method and Results. Source recordings and previous published derivatives are unchanged.
notes: G1 clips retain the exact previously reviewed source intervals from reports/media-revision.json.
No output contains an audio stream or source capture metadata.
Field clips are derived from the existing SDR/BT.709 silent rendering of the team’s self-recorded IMG_7082 (1).MOV.
G1 excerpts end before the later loss-of-balance or reset sequences and illustrate selected supervised movements rather than complete successful trials.
The opening is two silent videos of equal length side by side: three field excerpts on the left and two G1 excerpts on the right.
Each results clip pairs a roofer (left) with the G1 (right). Both halves are 360 × 480 crops that follow the person or robot; the robot crops stay right of the operator.
IMG_7081.MOV and IMG_7085.MOV are HDR (HLG) iPhone recordings, tone-mapped to SDR with a Hable curve. Source recordings are unchanged.

clips.title: Roofer at work
clips.caption: Opening film, left: a roofer at work on a pitched roof.
clips.description: A silent film of three shots at original speed, shown beside the robot. On an unfinished pitched roof, a worker carries a sheet of sheathing across the slope, bends over it with a handheld tool, and lowers into a deep crouch with both feet on the slope. Timber framing, neighboring houses, trees and sky are in view. This is field footage recorded by the research team.

clips.title: Opening film
clips.caption: Opening film, right: a G1 humanoid on a laboratory slope.
clips.description: A silent film of two shots at original speed, shown beside the roofer. In a laboratory, a Unitree G1 humanoid on a padded incline bends and lowers a handheld tool toward the pad, and in a separate trial bends deeply toward the surface. A safety tether is attached. The frame is cropped to follow the robot; the operator holding the controller stands just outside it. The robot shots end before later motion, falls, or resets and do not show fastening.

clips.title: Uphill walking
clips.caption: Uphill walking: a roofer on the left and the G1 on the right.
clips.description: Left, a roofer carries a sheet of sheathing up a pitched roof. Right, a Unitree G1 humanoid walks from the floor onto a padded incline. The two halves come from separate recordings shown side by side, so their motions are not synchronized. The robot is in a laboratory with an overhead safety tether attached, and the frame is cropped so the operator holding the controller stands just outside it. The robot excerpt ends before later motion, falls, or resets and does not show fastening. Silent, at original speed.

clips.title: Bending
clips.caption: Bending: a roofer on the left and the G1 on the right.
clips.description: Left, a roofer sets down a sheet of sheathing and bends low to reach the roof surface. Right, a Unitree G1 humanoid bends deeply toward a padded incline. The two halves come from separate recordings shown side by side, so their motions are not synchronized. The robot is in a laboratory with an overhead safety tether attached, and the frame is cropped so the operator holding the controller stands just outside it. The robot excerpt ends before later motion, falls, or resets and does not show fastening. Silent, at original speed.

clips.title: Nailgun positioning
clips.caption: Nailgun positioning: a roofer on the left and the G1 on the right.
clips.description: Left, a roofer bends over the sheathing with a pneumatic nailer close to the surface. Right, a Unitree G1 humanoid steps forward on a padded incline, bends, and lowers a handheld tool toward the pad. The two halves come from separate recordings shown side by side, so their motions are not synchronized. The robot is in a laboratory with an overhead safety tether attached, and the frame is cropped so the operator holding the controller stands just outside it. The robot excerpt ends before later motion, falls, or resets and does not show fastening. Silent, at original speed.

clips.title: Hammer positioning
clips.caption: Hammer positioning: a roofer on the left and the G1 on the right.
clips.description: Left, a roofer braces a sheet of sheathing with one hand and holds a hammer in the other. Right, a Unitree G1 humanoid steps forward and bends deeply, bringing its hand and tool close to the padded surface. The two halves come from separate recordings shown side by side, so their motions are not synchronized. The robot is in a laboratory with an overhead safety tether attached, and the frame is cropped so the operator holding the controller stands just outside it. The robot excerpt ends before later motion, falls, or resets and does not show fastening. Silent, at original speed.
